nodes.nie.text.t: "Pity. I'll go when the knee lets me." The herbalist sighs and swears under his breath, at some length.

nodes.s.text.t: On the road, a herbalist with a basket full of grain and herbs. "Mirogost. I won't make it to the herbalist's hut in the marshes, my knee's given out on me. Will you take her this basket? She knows what to do with it."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: Mirogost hands over the basket with great ceremony, as if he were giving away a child. "Don't open it, or they'll fly off. Herbs have a mind of their own."
